resources.string: App volume, gain, fine adjustment and loudness
Controls audio played on this phone, including streamed tracks. Android media volume and USB DAC volume remain separate. Remote playback on a PC or cast receiver uses that device’s volume.
USB bit-perfect output bypasses these controls, including mute. Use the DAC’s hardware volume.
Caps app volume + gain + ReplayGain before the peak limiter. This is a gain setting, not a measured sound level or a limit on Android or DAC volume.
Positive gain can clip loud tracks. Enable the peak limiter below to control sample peaks.
